i modified the flashback rules for DnD

**Flashbacks.** Adapted for D&D from the Blades in the Dark TTRPG System. It will be employed in the heist one-shot, so there's less planning going on.

- Each character has a number of Flashback points equal to their Intelligence modifier (minimum of 1).

- In the middle of a "job", a player can choose to pause the action to spend a Flashback point and declare a flashback. Explain what your character did in the past to prepare for the current situation. We will run the flashback scene and play it out (roleplay, roll ability checks, etc.) to determine how successful your flashback is in affecting the present situation.

- A flashback can't change anything that has already happened. If a guard rolls up in front of you, you can't declare a flashback that you assassinated him the night before. 

- A flashback can't happen within another flashback, or while in initiative.

- Only one flashback can be used for a certain problem. If one character fails during their flashback, another one can't step in to declare their own flashback for the same problem.

- Limited Use abilities, features, and itmes like spell slots or potions consumed during the flashback will not be replenished. "This happened yesterday and I took a long rest" will not apply.
